units.zh: 沮渠蒙遜，臨松盧水胡人也。
units.en: Juqu Mengxun was a Lu-shui Hu from Linsong.
units.literal: Juqu Mengxun was a man of the Lu-water Hu of Linsong.

units.zh: 其先世為匈奴左沮渠，遂以官為氏焉。
units.en: His forebears had held the Xiongnu title of Left Juqu, and the family took that office as its surname.
units.literal: His ancestors for generations had been the Xiongnu's left Juqu, thereupon taking the office as clan.

units.zh: 蒙遜博涉群史，頗曉天文，雄傑有英略，滑稽善權變，梁熙、呂光皆奇而憚之，故常遊飲自晦。
units.en: Mengxun read widely in history, knew something of astronomy, was bold and resourceful, and had a ready wit for stratagem; Liang Xi and Lü Guang both admired and feared him, so he often hid his light beneath feasting and drink.
units.literal: Mengxun broadly crossed the many histories, rather understood celestial patterns, was heroic and outstanding with heroic plans, witty and good at power shifts; Liang Xi and Lü Guang both marveled at yet feared him, therefore he often roamed and drank to dim himself.

units.zh: 會伯父羅仇、麹粥從呂光征河南，光前軍大敗，麹粥言于兄羅仇曰：「主上荒耄驕縱，諸子朋黨相傾，讒人側目。
units.en: When his uncles Luoqiu and Quzhou followed Lü Guang on the southern campaign, Lü Guang's vanguard suffered a crushing defeat. Quzhou said to his brother Luoqiu, "The ruler is senile and willful, his sons tear at one another in factions, and men who whisper slander watch for their chance.
units.literal: It happened that paternal uncles Luoqiu and Quzhou followed Lü Guang to campaign south of the River; Guang's vanguard was greatly defeated. Quzhou spoke to elder brother Luoqiu saying: "The lord above is wasteful, aged, arrogant, and unrestrained; the various sons form factions and overturn one another; slanderers watch with sidelong eyes.

units.zh: 今軍敗將死，正是智勇見猜之日，可不懼乎！
units.en: The army is broken and the generals are dying—this is the very hour when able men are marked for suspicion. Should we not be afraid!
units.literal: Now the army defeated and generals dying is just the day when the wise and brave are suspected—can one not fear!

units.zh: 吾兄弟素為所憚，與其經死溝瀆，豈若勒眾向西平，出苕藋，奮臂大呼，涼州不足定也。」
units.en: Our brothers have long been objects of fear; better to lead the host west to Xiping, break out through Tiaodiao, and raise a shout with arms flung high than to die like dogs in a ditch—Liangzhou would be ours for the taking."
units.literal: We brothers have long been what they fear; rather than hang dead in ditches and gullies, how is it compared to rallying the host toward Xiping, exiting Tiaodiao, raising arms and great shouting—Liangzhou is not enough to settle."

units.zh: 羅仇曰：「理如汝言，但吾家累世忠孝，為一方所歸，寧人負我，無我負人。」
units.en: Luoqiu replied, "Your reasoning is sound, yet our family has been loyal for generations and this region looks to us; I would rather another betray me than betray another."
units.literal: Luoqiu said: "The principle is as you say, but our house for generations has been loyal and filial, what one quarter turns to; better others betray me than I betray others."

units.zh: 俄而皆為光所殺。
units.en: Before long Lü Guang had them both put to death.
units.literal: Before long both were killed by Guang.

units.zh: 宗姻諸部會葬者萬餘人，蒙遜哭謂眾曰：「昔漢祚中微，吾之乃祖翼獎竇融，保寧河右。
units.en: More than ten thousand kinsmen and allies came to the funeral. Mengxun wept and told the crowd, "When the Han mandate faltered, my ancestor aided Dou Rong and helped secure the country west of the Yellow River.
units.literal: Clan and marriage various divisions assembling for the funeral exceeded ten thousand; Mengxun wept and said to the masses: "Formerly when Han's mandate was mid-faint, my ancestor aided and encouraged Dou Rong, preserving and quieting the west of the River.

units.zh: 呂王昏耄，荒虐無道，豈可不上繼先祖安時之志，使二父有恨黃泉！」
units.en: The Lü king is senile and cruel without principle—can we fail to carry on our forebears' wish for peace and leave our two fathers unrevenged in the grave!"
units.literal: The Lü king is dim and aged, wasteful and cruel without the Way—how can we not upward continue the ancestors' intent to pacify the times, causing the two fathers to harbor resentment in the Yellow Springs!"

units.zh: 眾咸稱萬歲。
units.en: The crowd shouted their assent.
units.literal: The mass all shouted ten thousand years.

units.zh: 遂斬光中田護軍馬邃、臨松令井祥以盟，一旬之間，眾至萬餘。
units.en: They slew Ma Sui, the central-field guard under Lü Guang, and Jing Xiang, magistrate of Linsong, to seal their oath, and within ten days their following passed ten thousand.
units.literal: Thereupon they beheaded Guang's central-field guard commander Ma Sui and Linsong magistrate Jing Xiang to covenant; within one ten-day, the host reached over ten thousand.

units.zh: 屯據金山，與從兄男成推光建康太守段業為使持節、大都督、龍驤大將軍、涼州牧、建康公，改呂光龍飛二年為神璽元年。
units.en: They occupied Jin Mountain and, with his cousin Juqu Nancheng, set up Duan Ye, Lü Guang's governor of Jiankang, as commissioner with full powers, grand commander, grand general soaring dragon, governor of Liangzhou, and Duke of Jiankang, reckoning the first year of their rule from Lü Guang's second year of Longfei under the new era name Shenxi.
units.literal: They encamped and held Jin Mountain; with elder male cousin Nancheng they raised Guang's Jiankang governor Duan Ye as commissioner bearing credentials, grand commander, soaring-dragon great general, Liangzhou shepherd, Duke of Jiankang, changing Lü Guang's second year of Longfei to the first year of Shenxi.

units.zh: 業以蒙遜為張掖太守，男成為輔國將軍，委以軍國之任。
units.en: Duan Ye named Mengxun governor of Zhangye and Nancheng general who supports the state, entrusting them with civil and military power.
units.literal: Ye appointed Mengxun as Zhangye governor, Nancheng as bulwark-of-state general, entrusting them army and state's tasks.

units.zh: 業將使蒙遜攻西郡，眾咸疑之。
units.en: When Duan Ye was about to send Mengxun against Xijun, his officers were skeptical.
units.literal: Ye was about to order Mengxun to attack Xijun; the mass all doubted it.

units.zh: 蒙遜曰：「此郡據嶺之要，不可不取。」
units.en: Mengxun said, "That commandery guards the ridge line; we must take it."
units.literal: Mengxun said: "This commandery holds the pass's key; must take it."

units.zh: 業曰：「卿言是也。」
units.en: Duan Ye said, "You are right."
units.literal: Ye said: "Your words are right."

units.zh: 遂遣之。
units.en: He sent him off.
units.literal: Thereupon sent him.

units.zh: 蒙遜引水灌城，城潰，執太守呂純以歸。
units.en: Mengxun diverted water to flood the city; the city fell, and he returned with its governor Lü Chun as a prisoner.
units.literal: Mengxun led water to flood the city; the city collapsed; seized governor Lü Chun and returned.

units.zh: 於是王德以晉昌，孟敏以敦煌降業。
units.en: Wang De then surrendered Jinchang and Meng Min surrendered Dunhuang to Duan Ye.
units.literal: Thereupon Wang De with Jinchang, Meng Min with Dunhuang submitted to Ye.

units.zh: 業封蒙遜臨池侯。
units.en: Duan Ye enfeoffed Mengxun as marquis of Linchi.
units.literal: Ye enfeoffed Mengxun as marquis of Linchi.

units.zh: 呂弘去張掖，將東走，業議欲擊之。
units.en: When Lü Hong left Zhangye and was about to flee east, Duan Ye considered attacking him.
units.literal: Lü Hong left Zhangye, about to flee east; Ye deliberated desiring to strike him.

units.zh: 蒙遜諫曰：「歸師勿遏，窮寇弗追，此兵家之戎也。
units.en: Mengxun remonstrated, "Do not bar a retreating army or press a cornered foe—such is the soldier's rule.
units.literal: Mengxun remonstrated saying: "Returning hosts do not block; exhausted bandits are not pursued—this is the military specialists' precept.

units.zh: 不如縱之，以為後圖。」
units.en: Better to let them go and plan for another day."
units.literal: Better to release them, thereby for later planning."

units.zh: 業曰：「一日縱敵，悔將無及。」
units.en: Duan Ye replied, "Let the enemy slip once and regret will come too late."
units.literal: Ye said: "One day releasing the enemy, regret will not reach."

units.zh: 遂率眾追之，為弘所敗。
units.en: He led the army in pursuit and was routed by Lü Hong.
units.literal: Thereupon led the host pursuing him, was defeated by Hong.

units.zh: 業賴蒙遜而免，歎曰：「孤不能用子房之言，以至於此！」
units.en: Duan Ye owed his escape to Mengxun and sighed, "I would not heed the counsel of a Zhang Liang, and this is the price!"
units.literal: Ye relied on Mengxun to escape, sighed saying: "I could not use Zifang's words, thereby reaching to this!"

units.zh: 業築西安城，以其將臧莫孩為太守。
units.en: He walled Xi'an and named his general Zang Mohai governor.
units.literal: Ye built Xi'an city, taking his general Zang Mohai as governor.

units.zh: 蒙遜曰：「莫孩勇而無謀，知進忘退，所謂為之築塚，非築城也。」
units.en: Mengxun said, "Mohai is brave but witless, ever eager to advance and never to withdraw—you are digging his grave, not raising a wall for him."
units.literal: Mengxun said: "Mohai is brave but without plans, knows advance forgets retreat—what is called for him building a tomb, not building a city."

units.zh: 業不從。
units.en: Duan Ye would not listen.
units.literal: Ye did not follow.

units.zh: 俄而為呂纂所敗。
units.en: Soon afterward Zang Mohai was defeated by Lü Zuan.
units.literal: Before long was defeated by Lü Zuan.

units.zh: 蒙遜懼業不能容己，每匿智以避之。
units.en: Mengxun feared that Duan Ye could not tolerate him and constantly feigned dullness to stay out of his way.
units.literal: Mengxun feared Ye could not tolerate him, always hiding wisdom to avoid him.

units.zh: 業僭稱涼王，以蒙遜為尚書左丞，梁中庸為右丞。
units.en: When Duan Ye assumed the title of king of Liang, he made Mengxun left secretary of the masters of writing and Liang Zhongyong right secretary.
units.literal: Ye usurpingly styled himself king of Liang, appointed Mengxun as left aide of the masters of writing, Liang Zhongyong as right aide.

units.zh: 呂光遣其二子紹、纂伐業，業請救于禿髮烏孤，烏孤遣其弟鹿孤及楊軌救業。
units.en: Lü Guang sent his sons Shao and Zuan against Duan Ye, who begged aid from Tufa Wugu; Wugu sent his brother Lugu and Yang Gui to relieve him.
units.literal: Lü Guang dispatched his two sons Shao and Zuan to campaign against Ye; Ye requested rescue from Tufa Wugu; Wugu sent his younger brother Lugu and Yang Gui to rescue Ye.

units.zh: 紹以業等軍盛，欲從三門關挾山而東。
units.en: Lü Shao saw that Duan Ye's host was strong and proposed to slip east along the mountains through Sanmen Pass.
units.literal: Shao because Ye and others' army was strong, wished to follow Sanmen Pass hugging the mountains eastward.

units.zh: 纂曰：「挾山示弱，取敗之道，不如結陣衛之，彼必憚我而不戰也。」
units.en: Lü Zuan said, "Skirting the mountains advertises weakness and courts defeat; better to form a battle line and hold them—they will fear us and refuse battle."
units.literal: Zuan said: "Hugging the mountains shows weakness—the way to take defeat; better to array formations and guard them; they will surely fear us and not fight."

units.zh: 紹乃引軍而南。
units.en: Lü Shao therefore marched south.
units.literal: Shao thereupon led the army southward.

units.zh: 業將擊之，蒙遜諫曰：「楊軌恃虜騎之強，有窺覦之志。
units.en: As Duan Ye prepared to attack, Mengxun remonstrated, "Yang Gui trusts in the strength of his nomad horse and eyes your throne for himself.
units.literal: Ye was about to strike them; Mengxun remonstrated saying: "Yang Gui relies on barbarian cavalry's strength, has covetous intent.

units.zh: 紹、纂兵在死地，必決戰求生。
units.en: Shao and Zuan are on deadly ground; they will fight to the death.
units.literal: Shao and Zuan's troops are on dead ground; they must join battle to seek life.

units.zh: 不戰則有太山之安，戰則有累卵之危。」
units.en: Refuse battle and you are secure as Mount Tai; join battle and you stand on eggs piled high."
units.literal: If not fighting then there is Mount Tai's peace; if fighting then there is piled-eggs' peril."

units.zh: 業曰：「卿言是也。」
units.en: Duan Ye said, "You speak truly."
units.literal: Ye said: "Your words are right."

units.zh: 乃按兵不戰。
units.en: He held his troops and gave no battle.
units.literal: Thereupon held the army and did not fight.

units.zh: 紹亦難之，各引兵歸。
units.en: Lü Shao found the situation awkward as well, and both sides withdrew.
units.literal: Shao also found it hard; each led troops back.

units.zh: 業憚蒙遜雄武，微欲遠之，乃以蒙遜從叔益生為酒泉太守，蒙遜為臨池太守。
units.en: Duan Ye feared Mengxun's prowess and wished to edge him aside; he named Mengxun's uncle Yisheng governor of Jiuquan and Mengxun governor of Linchi.
units.literal: Ye feared Mengxun's heroic martialness, slightly wished to distance him; thereupon made Mengxun's paternal uncle Yisheng Jiuquan governor, Mengxun Linchi governor.

units.zh: 業門下侍郎馬權雋爽有逸氣，武略過人。
units.en: Ma Quan, Duan Ye's Gentleman Attendant of the Chancellery (menxia shilang), was dashing and brilliant, with military talent above the common run.
units.literal: Ye's gentleman attendant of the chancellery Ma Quan was handsome and bright with transcendent qi, martial plans surpassing others.

units.zh: 業以權代蒙遜為張掖太守，甚見親重，每輕陵蒙遜。
units.en: Duan Ye replaced Mengxun with Ma Quan as governor of Zhangye and favored him so heavily that Ma Quan regularly slighted Mengxun.
units.literal: Ye used Quan to replace Mengxun as Zhangye governor; he was very seen as intimate and weighty, often lightly insulting Mengxun.

units.zh: 蒙遜亦憚而怨之，乃譖之於業曰：「天下不足慮，惟當憂馬權耳。」
units.en: Mengxun feared and hated him and said to Duan Ye, "The realm is no concern—only Ma Quan should worry you."
units.literal: Mengxun also feared and resented him, thereupon slandered him to Ye saying: "All under Heaven is not worth worry; only ought to worry Ma Quan."

units.zh: 業遂殺之。
units.en: Duan Ye had Ma Quan executed.
units.literal: Ye thereupon killed him.

units.zh: 蒙遜謂男成曰：「段業愚暗，非濟亂之才，信讒愛佞，無鑒斷之明。
units.en: Mengxun said to Nancheng, "Duan Ye is a dullard, no man to save a crisis; he heeds slander and dotes on toadies and cannot judge men.
units.literal: Mengxun said to Nancheng: "Duan Ye is foolish and dark, not talent to aid disorder, trusts slander and loves flatterers, without mirror-judgment's clarity.

units.zh: 所憚惟索嗣、馬權，今皆死矣，蒙遜欲除業以奉兄何如？」
units.en: He feared only Suosi and Ma Quan, and both are dead. I mean to remove Duan Ye and set you up, brother—what say you?"
units.literal: What he feared was only Suosi and Ma Quan; now both are dead; Mengxun wishes to remove Ye to serve elder brother—how about it?"

units.zh: 男成曰：「業羈旅孤飄，我所建立，有吾兄弟，猶魚之有水，人既親我，背之不祥。」
units.en: Nancheng replied, "Duan Ye is a wanderer whom we raised to the throne; we are to him as water to fish. The people trust us; to betray him would be ill-omened."
units.literal: Nancheng said: "Ye is sojourner alone adrift; what I established; having us brothers is like fish having water; men already are intimate with me; turning the back on them is not auspicious."

units.zh: 乃止。
units.en: Mengxun dropped the plan.
units.literal: Thereupon stopped.

units.zh: 蒙遜既為業所憚，內不自安，請為西安太守。
units.en: Since Duan Ye still feared him, Mengxun felt uneasy and asked to be governor of Xi'an.
units.literal: Mengxun having been feared by Ye, within was not self at peace, requested to be Xi'an governor.

units.zh: 業亦以蒙遜有大志，懼為朝夕之變，乃許焉。
units.en: Duan Ye knew Mengxun nursed a great ambition and feared a coup at any hour, so he granted the request.
units.literal: Ye also because Mengxun had great aims, feared dawn-and-dusk change, thereupon granted it.

units.zh: 蒙遜期與男成同祭蘭門山，密遣司馬許咸告業曰：「男成欲謀叛，許以取假日作逆。
units.en: Mengxun arranged to sacrifice with Nancheng on Mount Lanmen while secretly sending his aide Xu Xian to tell Duan Ye, "Nancheng plans to rebel and intends to use a holiday leave to strike.
units.literal: Mengxun set a date with Nancheng jointly to sacrifice at Lanmen Mountain, secretly sent major Xu Xian to tell Ye saying: "Nancheng desires to plot rebellion, promising to take a leave day to commit treason.

units.zh: 若求祭蘭門山，臣言驗矣。」
units.en: If he asks leave to sacrifice on Lanmen Mountain, you will know my words are true."
units.literal: If he requests to sacrifice at Lanmen Mountain, your subject's words are verified."

units.zh: 至期日，果然。
units.en: When the day came, Nancheng did exactly as foretold.
units.literal: When the appointed day arrived, it was so.

units.zh: 業收男成，令自殺。
units.en: Duan Ye seized Nancheng and ordered him to take his own life.
units.literal: Ye seized Nancheng, ordered him to kill himself.

units.zh: 男成曰：「蒙遜欲謀叛，先已告臣，臣以兄弟之故，隱忍不言。
units.en: Nancheng said, "Mengxun long ago told me of his plot to rebel, but I held my tongue for our brotherhood.
units.literal: Nancheng said: "Mengxun desires to plot rebellion, already beforehand told your subject; your subject because of brothers' relation, bore it in silence and did not speak.

units.zh: 以臣今在，恐部人不從，與臣克期祭山，返相誣告。
units.en: While I live his men might not follow him, so he set this mountain rite with me and then denounced me to you.
units.literal: Because your subject now exists, he fears the division will not follow; with your subject he set a date to sacrifice on the mountain, then turned to slander and report.

units.zh: 臣若朝死，蒙遜必夕發。
units.en: Kill me at dawn and he will rebel at dusk.
units.literal: If your subject dies at dawn, Mengxun will surely rise at evening.

units.zh: 乞詐言臣死，說臣罪惡，蒙遜必作逆，臣投袂討之，事無不捷。」
units.en: Feign my execution and publish my crimes; Mengxun will then rise in open revolt, and I can throw off restraint and strike him—not a stroke can fail."
units.literal: Beg falsely to say your subject dead, declare your subject's crimes and evil; Mengxun will surely commit treason; your subject will cast sleeve and punish him—affairs without not victory."

units.zh: 業不從。
units.en: Duan Ye would not hear it.
units.literal: Ye did not follow.

units.zh: 蒙遜聞男成死，泣告眾曰：「男成忠於段公，枉見屠害，諸君能為報仇乎？
units.en: When Mengxun heard that Nancheng was dead, he wept before the host and said, "Nancheng was loyal to Lord Duan and has been murdered. Will you avenge him?
units.literal: Mengxun heard Nancheng died, weeping told the masses saying: "Nancheng was loyal to Duke Duan, wrongly saw slaughter and harm—gentlemen, can you avenge him?

units.zh: 且州土兵亂，似非業所能濟。
units.en: The province is in arms; Duan Ye is no man to set it right.
units.literal: Moreover the province's soil and soldiers in chaos, seems not what Ye is able to aid.

units.zh: 吾所以初奉之者，以之為陳、吳耳，而信讒多忌，枉害忠良，豈可安枕臥觀，使百姓離于塗炭。」
units.en: I raised him at first thinking him another Chen Sheng or Wu Guang, yet he trusts slander, suspects everyone, and kills the loyal—can we sleep while the people burn?"
units.literal: The reason I at first served him was taking him for Chen and Wu; yet trusting slander, much jealousy, wrongly harming loyal and good—how can one pillow in peace and lie watching, causing the hundred surnames to suffer mud and charcoal?"

units.zh: 男成素有恩信，眾皆憤泣而從之。
units.en: Nancheng had long won the men's love; they wept with rage and rallied to Mengxun.
units.literal: Nancheng always had grace and trust; the mass all angrily wept and followed him.

units.zh: 比至氐池，眾逾一萬。
units.en: By the time he reached Dichi his following passed ten thousand.
units.literal: By reaching Dichi, the host exceeded ten thousand.

units.zh: 鎮軍臧莫孩率部眾附之，羌胡多起兵回應。
units.en: Zang Mohai, garrison general, brought his command to join him, and Qiang and Hu bands rose everywhere in support.
units.literal: Garrison-general Zang Mohai led division masses to attach to him; Qiang and Hu many raised troops in echoing response.

units.zh: 蒙遜壁于侯塢。
units.en: Mengxun fortified Houwu.
units.literal: Mengxun walled at Houwu.

units.zh: 業先疑其右將軍田昂，幽之於內，至是，謝而赦之，使與武衛梁中庸等攻蒙遜。
units.en: Duan Ye had long suspected his general of the right, Tian Ang, and kept him under house arrest; now he apologized, freed him, and sent him with Liang Zhongyong of the martial guard and others against Mengxun.
units.literal: Ye earlier suspected his right general Tian Ang, imprisoned him within; reaching this, apologized and pardoned him, ordered him together with martial guard Liang Zhongyong and others to attack Mengxun.

units.zh: 業將王豐孫言于業曰：「西平諸田，世有反者，昂貌恭而心很，志大而情險，不可信也。」
units.en: Wang Fengsun warned Duan Ye, "The Tian of Xiping have rebelled in every generation; Tian Ang looks humble but his heart is cruel, his ambition large and his temper treacherous—do not trust him."
units.literal: Ye's general Wang Fengsun spoke to Ye saying: "Among Xiping's Tian clan, generation after generation has had rebels; Ang's appearance is respectful but his heart is cruel, aims large but disposition perilous—not trustworthy."

units.zh: 業曰：「吾疑之久矣，但非昂無可以討蒙遜。」
units.en: Duan Ye said, "I have doubted him long, yet no one but Tian Ang can face Mengxun."
units.literal: Ye said: "I have suspected him long; yet except Ang none can be used to punish Mengxun."

units.zh: 豐孫言既不從，昂至侯塢，率騎五百歸於蒙遜。
units.en: Duan Ye brushed the warning aside; when Tian Ang reached Houwu he brought five hundred horsemen over to Mengxun.
units.literal: Fengsun's words not followed, when Ang reached Houwu, led five hundred horse and submitted to Mengxun.

units.zh: 蒙遜至張掖，昂兄子承愛斬關內之，業左右皆散。
units.en: Mengxun marched on Zhangye; Cheng'ai, Tian Ang's nephew, cut the gate bars and let him in, and Duan Ye's guards melted away.
units.literal: Mengxun reached Zhangye; Ang's elder brother's son Cheng'ai cut open the gate and admitted him; Ye's left and right all scattered.

units.zh: 蒙遜大呼曰：「鎮西何在？」
units.en: Mengxun shouted, "Where is the general who guards the west?"
units.literal: Mengxun great shouted saying: "Where is the General Who Guards the West?"

units.zh: 軍人曰：「在此。」
units.en: The soldiers said, "Here."
units.literal: Soldiers said: "Here."

units.zh: 業曰：「孤單飄一己，為貴門所推，可見丐餘命，投身嶺南，庶得東還，與妻子相見。」
units.en: Duan Ye said, "I am one man alone, raised by your house; grant me my life and banish me south of the ranges so I may someday return east to my wife and children."
units.literal: Ye said: "I alone drift a single self, pushed by your noble gate; may I beg spare life, cast body south of the ranges, perhaps obtain east return, to meet wife and children."

units.zh: 蒙遜遂斬之。
units.en: Mengxun beheaded him.
units.literal: Mengxun thereupon beheaded him.

units.zh: 業，京兆人也。
units.en: Duan Ye came from Jingzhao.
units.literal: Ye was a man of Jingzhao.

units.zh: 博涉史傳，有尺牘之才，為杜進記室，從征塞表。
units.en: He was well read and a skilled writer; he served Du Jin as secretary and campaigned beyond the frontier.
units.literal: Broadly crossed histories and traditions, had letter-writing talent; was for Du Jin secretary, followed campaign beyond the passes.

units.zh: 儒素長者，無他權略，威禁不行，群下擅命，尤信卜筮、讖記、巫覡、征祥，故為奸佞所誤。
units.en: He was a bookish gentleman without political guile; he could not enforce authority and let his subordinates do as they pleased; he doted on diviners, prophecies, shamans, and omens, and so was led astray by villains.
units.literal: A Confucian plain elder, without other power stratagem, awe and prohibition not enforced, the host below usurped orders, especially trusted divination, prophecy records, shamans, and omens; therefore was misled by crafty flatterers.

units.zh: 隆安五年，梁中庸、房晷、田昂等推蒙遜為使持節、大都督、大將軍、涼州牧、張掖公，赦其境內，改元永安。
units.en: In the fifth year of Long'an, Liang Zhongyong, Fang Gui, Tian Ang, and others proclaimed Mengxun commissioner with full powers, grand commander, great general, governor of Liangzhou, and Duke of Zhangye, granted an amnesty within his domain, and adopted the era name Yong'an.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Long'an, Liang Zhongyong, Fang Gui, Tian Ang and others raised Mengxun as commissioner bearing credentials, grand commander, great general, Liangzhou shepherd, Duke of Zhangye, amnestied within his borders, changed era to Yong'an.

units.zh: 署從兄伏奴為鎮軍將軍、張掖太守、和平侯，弟挐為建忠將軍、都谷侯，田昂為鎮南將軍、西郡太守，臧莫孩為輔國將軍，房晷、梁中庸為左右長史，張騭、謝正禮為左右司馬。
units.en: He named his cousin Funu garrison general, governor of Zhangye, and marquis of Heping; his brother Nu general who establishes loyalty and marquis of Dugu; Tian Ang general who guards the south and governor of Xijun; Zang Mohai general who supports the state; Fang Gui and Liang Zhongyong chief clerks left and right; Zhang Zhi and Xie Zhengli majors of the left and right.
units.literal: He appointed elder male cousin Funu as garrison-general, Zhangye governor, marquis of Heping; younger brother Nu as establish-fidelity general, marquis of Dugu; Tian Ang as guard-south general, Xijun governor; Zang Mohai as bulwark-of-state general; Fang Gui and Liang Zhongyong as left and right senior clerks; Zhang Zhi and Xie Zhengli as left and right majors.

units.zh: 擢任賢才，文武咸悅。
units.en: He promoted able men, and both civil and military arms were pleased.
units.literal: Raising and employing worthy talents, civil and military all rejoiced.

units.zh: 時姚興遣將姚碩德攻呂隆于姑臧，蒙遜遣從事中郎李典聘於興，以通和好。
units.en: While Yao Xing sent Yao Shuode against Lü Long at Guzang, Mengxun sent his staff officer Li Dian to court Yao Xing and open friendly relations.
units.literal: At the time Yao Xing dispatched general Yao Shuode to attack Lü Long at Guzang; Mengxun sent attendant gentleman Li Dian to visit Xing, thereby to open peace and friendship.

units.zh: 蒙遜以呂隆既降於興，酒泉、涼寧二郡叛降李玄盛，乃遣建忠挐、牧府長史張潛見碩德于姑臧，請軍迎接，率郡人東遷。
units.en: After Lü Long surrendered to Yao Xing, Jiuquan and Liangning went over to Li Xuansheng; Mengxun sent his brother Nu and chief clerk Zhang Qian to Yao Shuode at Guzang to ask for an escort and lead his people eastward.
units.literal: Mengxun because Lü Long had already submitted to Xing, Jiuquan and Liangning two commanderies rebelled and submitted to Li Xuansheng, thereupon sent establish-fidelity Nu, shepherd mansion senior clerk Zhang Qian to see Shuode at Guzang, requesting an army to welcome and lead, leading the commandery people east to migrate.

units.zh: 碩德大悅，拜潛張掖太守，挐建康太守。
units.en: Shuode was delighted and named Zhang Qian governor of Zhangye and Nu governor of Jiankang.
units.literal: Shuode greatly pleased, appointed Qian Zhangye governor, Nu Jiankang governor.

units.zh: 潛勸蒙遜東遷。
units.en: Zhang Qian urged Mengxun to move east.
units.literal: Qian urged Mengxun east to migrate.

units.zh: 挐私于蒙遜曰：「呂氏猶存，姑臧未拔，碩德糧竭將遠，不能久也。
units.en: Nu said privately to Mengxun, "The Lü still hold out in Guzang; Shuode's supplies will run out and he will withdraw—he cannot stay long.
units.literal: Nu privately to Mengxun said: "The Lü clan still exists, Guzang not yet taken; Shuode's grain exhausted will be distant, cannot long endure.

units.zh: 何故違離桑梓，受制於人！」
units.en: Why leave our native soil to become another man's pawn!"
units.literal: What reason to violate and leave mulberry and catalpa, receive control from others!"

units.zh: 輔國莫孩曰：「建忠之言是也。」
units.en: Zang Mohai said, "The general who establishes loyalty speaks true."
units.literal: Bulwark-of-state Mohai said: "Establish-fidelity's words are right."

units.zh: 蒙遜乃斬張潛，因下書曰：「孤以虛薄，猥忝時運。
units.en: Mengxun executed Zhang Qian and issued an edict: "I am a man of slight merit unworthily raised by the times.
units.literal: Mengxun thereupon beheaded Zhang Qian, then issued a writ saying: "I, by empty shallowness, meanly am favored by the times' movement.

units.zh: 未能弘闡大獻，戡蕩群孽，使桃蟲鼓翼東京，封豕烝涉西裔，戎車屢動，干戈未戢，農失三時之業，百姓戶不粒食。
units.en: I have not crushed the rebels or stopped the peach-borer from flapping its wings in the eastern capital nor the great boar from trampling the western march; chariots roll without cease, arms are never laid down, the seasons' farming is lost, and the people go hungry from door to door.
units.literal: Unable to enlarge and open great offering, cut down and level the host of evils, causing the peach-worm to beat wings in the eastern capital, the great boar to steam-wade the western marches; war chariots repeatedly move, shields and spears not yet stored; farming loses the three seasons' work, the hundred surnames household by household lack grain food.

units.zh: 可蠲省百徭，專功南畝，明設科條，務盡地利。」
units.en: Let corvée be lightened so men may turn to the southern fields; set clear laws and wring the best from the soil."
units.literal: May remit and cut the hundred corvées, devote effort to the southern acres, clearly set statutes and articles, strive to exhaust earth's profit."

units.zh: 時梁中庸為西郡太守，西奔李玄盛。
units.en: Liang Zhongyong, then governor of Xijun, fled west to Li Xuansheng.
units.literal: At the time Liang Zhongyong was Xijun governor, fled west to Li Xuansheng.

units.zh: 蒙遜聞之，笑曰：「吾與中庸義深一體，而不信我，但自負耳，孤豈怪之！」
units.en: When Mengxun heard the news he laughed and said, "Zhongyong and I were as one in honor; if he could not trust me, the fault is his own—I bear him no grudge!"
units.literal: Mengxun heard it, laughed saying: "I and Zhongyong in righteousness are deep as one body, yet he does not trust me—only self-bears blame; how would I alone blame him!"

units.zh: 乃盡歸其妻孥。
units.en: He sent back Zhongyong's wife and children untouched.
units.literal: Thereupon wholly returned his wife and children.

units.zh: 蒙遜下令曰：「養老乞言，晉文納輿人之誦，所以能招禮英奇，致時邕之美。
units.en: Mengxun issued an order: "When Duke Wen of Jin honored the old and listened to the songs of the cart drivers, he drew worthy men and brought harmony to the age.
units.literal: Mengxun issued order saying: "Nurturing the aged and begging words, Jin Wen accepted the cart-men's chant—thereby able to summon and treat the heroic and strange, bring the age's harmony's beauty.

units.zh: 況孤寡德，智不經遠，而可不思聞讜言以自鏡哉！
units.en: How much more I, a man of shallow virtue and no long view—can I refuse to seek honest counsel for a mirror to my rule!
units.literal: Moreover I, of meager virtue, my wisdom not spanning far—yet how can one not think to hear straight words to serve as a mirror to myself!

units.zh: 內外群僚，其各搜揚賢雋，廣進芻蕘，以匡孤不逮。」
units.en: Let every officer within and without seek out the worthy and bring forward even the humblest counsel, to amend where I fall short."
units.literal: Inner and outer host of officials, each search and raise worthy and outstanding, broadly advance fodder-cutters' plans, thereby to rectify my not reaching."

units.zh: 遣輔國臧莫孩襲山北虜，大破之。
units.en: He sent Zang Mohai to strike the tribes north of the ranges and broke them decisively.
units.literal: He sent bulwark-of-state Zang Mohai to raid the northern tribes beyond the mountains and routed them greatly.

units.zh: 姚興遣將齊難率眾四萬迎呂隆，隆勸難伐蒙遜，難從之。
units.en: Yao Xing sent Qi Nan with forty thousand men to escort Lü Long; Lü Long persuaded Qi Nan to attack Mengxun, and Qi Nan agreed.
units.literal: Yao Xing dispatched general Qi Nan leading a host of forty thousand to welcome Lü Long; Long urged Nan to campaign against Mengxun, and Nan followed.

units.zh: 莫孩敗其前軍，難乃結盟而還。
units.en: Zang Mohai shattered Qi Nan's van, whereupon Qi Nan made peace and withdrew.
units.literal: Mohai defeated his vanguard; Nan then made covenant and returned.

units.zh: 蒙遜伯父中田護軍親信、臨松太守孔篤並驕奢侵害，百姓苦之。
units.en: Mengxun's uncles Qinxin, warden of the central fields, and Kong Du, governor of Linsong, were arrogant predators, and the people groaned under them.
units.literal: Mengxun's paternal uncles, Central-Field Protector Qinxin and Linsong governor Kong Du, together were arrogant and wasteful, encroaching and harming; the hundred surnames suffered them.

units.zh: 蒙遜曰：「亂吾國者，二伯父也，何以綱紀百姓乎！」
units.en: Mengxun said, "Those two uncles are the men who ruin my state—how can I rule the people while they live!"
units.literal: Mengxun said: "Those who disorder my state are the two uncles—how thereby to regulate the hundred surnames!"

units.zh: 皆令自殺。
units.en: He compelled both to take their own lives.
units.literal: He ordered both to kill themselves.

units.zh: 蒙遜襲狄洛磐於番禾，不克，遷其五百餘戶而還。
units.en: Mengxun struck Di Luoquan at Fanhe, failed to take him, and carried off over five hundred households on the retreat.
units.literal: Mengxun raided Di Luoquan at Fanhe, did not overcome him, moved more than five hundred households and returned.

units.zh: 姚興遣使人梁斐、張構等拜蒙遜鎮西大將軍、沙州刺史、西海侯。
units.en: Yao Xing sent Liang Fei and Zhang Gou to invest Mengxun as grand general who guards the west, governor of Shazhou, and marquis of Xihai.
units.literal: At the time Yao Xing dispatched envoys Liang Fei and Zhang Gou and others to appoint Mengxun grand general who guards the west, governor of Shazhou, marquis of Xihai.

units.zh: 時興亦拜禿髮傉檀為車騎將軍，封廣武公。
units.en: Yao Xing at the same time named Tufa Nutan general of chariots and cavalry and duke of Guangwu.
units.literal: At the time Xing also appointed Tufa Nutan chariot-and-cavalry general, enfeoffing him duke of Guangwu.

units.zh: 蒙遜聞之，不悅，謂斐等曰：「傉檀上公之位，而身為侯者何也！」
units.en: Mengxun took this ill and asked the envoys, "Nutan enjoys a higher noble rank than I, yet I am only a marquis—how is that fair?"
units.literal: Mengxun heard it, was not pleased, said to Fei and others: "Nutan holds upper duke rank, yet his person is marquis—why!"

units.zh: 構對曰：「傉檀輕狡不仁，款誠未著，聖朝所以加其重爵者，褒其歸善即敘之義耳。
units.en: Zhang Gou answered, "Nutan is fickle and cruel and has not proved his loyalty; the court raised his rank only to reward his willingness to submit.
units.literal: Gou replied saying: "Nutan is light, crafty, and not benevolent; sincere good faith not yet manifest—the sagely court therefore added his heavy noble is to praise his returning to good and immediate ordering's meaning only.

units.zh: 將軍忠貫白日，勳高一時，當入諧鼎味，匡贊帝室，安可以不信待也。
units.en: Your loyalty shines like the sun and your deeds tower above the age; you should soon sit among the highest ministers and aid the throne—how could the court distrust you!
units.literal: The general's loyalty pierces the white sun, merit towers above the age; he ought to enter harmonized tripod flavor, assist and praise the imperial house—how can he be met with distrust!

units.zh: 聖朝爵必稱功，官不越德，如尹緯、姚晁佐命初基，齊難、徐洛元勳驍將，並位才二品，爵止侯伯。
units.en: In the Later Qin, rank always matches merit—as when Yin Wei and Yao Chao served at the founding, or Qi Nan and Xu Luo led the van—none rose above the second grade and none held more than a marquisate.
units.literal: The sagely court's nobility must match merit, offices do not surpass virtue—as Yin Wei and Yao Chao aided the mandate at the beginning, Qi Nan and Xu Luo were first-rank fierce generals, yet rank reached only the second grade and noble title stopped at marquis or earl.

units.zh: 將軍何以先之乎？
units.en: Why should you rank ahead of such men?
units.literal: How does the general precede them?

units.zh: 竇融殷勤固讓，不欲居舊臣之右，未解將軍忽有此問！」
units.en: Dou Rong modestly refused to outrank the old ministers—why should you take offense at your place in the list!"
units.literal: Dou Rong earnestly and firmly declined, not wishing to sit to the right of old ministers—I do not understand the general's suddenly having this question!

units.zh: 蒙遜曰：「朝廷何不即以張掖見封，乃更遠封西海邪？」
units.en: Mengxun said, "Why not enfeoff me at Zhangye outright, instead of pushing me off to distant Xihai!"
units.literal: Mengxun said: "Why does the court not at once enfeoff Zhangye on me, yet instead enfeoff Xihai far away!"

units.zh: 構曰：「張掖，規畫之內，將軍已自有之。
units.en: Zhang Gou replied, "Zhangye already lies within your grasp.
units.literal: Gou said: "Zhangye lies within planned demarcation; the general already possesses it himself.

units.zh: 所以遠授西海者，蓋欲廣大將軍之國耳。」
units.en: The distant title of Xihai is meant only to widen your domain."
units.literal: The reason for distantly awarding Xihai is surely wishing to enlarge the general's state.

units.zh: 蒙遜大悅，乃受拜。
units.en: Mengxun was satisfied and accepted the investiture.
units.literal: Mengxun was greatly pleased, thereupon received the appointment.

units.zh: 時地震，山崩折木。
units.en: An earthquake struck; mountains slid and timber snapped.
units.literal: At the time there was an earthquake; mountains collapsed and trees broke.

units.zh: 太史令劉梁言于蒙遜曰：「辛酉，金也。
units.en: Liu Liang, director of astrology, told him, "The day xinyou belongs to metal.
units.literal: Astrologer-in-chief Liu Liang spoke to Mengxun saying: "Xinyou is metal.

units.zh: 地動于金，金動刻木，大軍東行無前之征。」
units.en: Earthquake on a metal day means metal overcomes wood—an omen that a great host will march east unopposed."
units.literal: Earth moved on metal; metal moved and carved wood—a great army's eastward march is the omen of nothing ahead.

units.zh: 時張掖城每有光色，蒙遜曰：「王氣將成，百戰百勝之象也。」
units.en: A strange glow played over Zhangye; Mengxun said, "The aura of kingship is gathering—an omen of victory in every fight."
units.literal: At the time Zhangye city repeatedly had light and color; Mengxun said: "Kingly qi is about to form—an image of a hundred battles, a hundred victories."

units.zh: 遂攻禿髮西郡太守楊統于日勒。
units.en: He then struck Tufa's governor of Xijun, Yang Tong, at Rile.
units.literal: Thereupon he attacked Tufa's Xijun governor Yang Tong at Rile.

units.zh: 統降，拜為右長史，寵逾功舊。
units.en: Yang Tong surrendered and was named chief clerk on the right with honors above the older retainers.
units.literal: Tong submitted; he was appointed right senior clerk, favor surpassing old merit.

units.zh: 張掖太守句呼勒出奔西涼。
units.en: Gouhule, governor of Zhangye, fled to the Western Liang.
units.literal: Zhangye governor Gouhule fled out to Western Liang.

units.zh: 以從弟成都為金山太守，羅仇子也；
units.en: He named his cousin Juqu Chengdu governor of Jinshan—Luoqiu's son;
units.literal: He appointed paternal cousin Chengdu as Jinshan governor—son of Luoqiu;

units.zh: 鄯為西郡太守，麹粥子也。
units.en: Juqu Shan governor of Xijun—Quzhou's son.
units.literal: Shan as Xijun governor—son of Quzhou.

units.zh: 句呼勒自西涼奔還，待之如初。
units.en: When Gouhule returned from the Western Liang, Mengxun received him as before.
units.literal: Gouhule fled back from Western Liang; he treated him as at first.

units.zh: 蒙遜率騎二萬東征，次於丹嶺，北虜大人思盤率部落三千降之。
units.en: Mengxun took twenty thousand cavalry east and camped at Danling; the northern chieftain Sipan brought three thousand tents to surrender.
units.literal: Mengxun led twenty thousand horse east to campaign, halted at Dan Ridge; northern barbarian great man Sipan led three thousand tribes to submit.

units.zh: 時木連理，生於永安，永安令張披上書曰：「異枝同幹，遐方有齊化之應；
units.en: Twin trunks joined in Yong'an; Magistrate Zhang Pi wrote, "Branches from one root show that distant lands are turning to your rule;
units.literal: At the time linked trees grew at Yong'an; Yong'an magistrate Zhang Pi submitted memorial saying: "Different branches, same trunk—distant regions have the response of equal transformation;

units.zh: 殊本共心，上下有莫二之固。
units.en: separate stocks with one heart show that high and low are bound as one;
units.literal: different roots, shared heart—above and below have un-second solidity.

units.zh: 蓋至道之嘉祥，大同之美征。」
units.en: this is the great omen of the Way and the sign of universal peace."
units.literal: this is the utmost Way's auspicious omen, the great concord's fine sign.

units.zh: 蒙遜曰：「此皆二千石令長匪躬濟時所致，豈吾薄德所能感之！」
units.en: Mengxun said, "That is the work of my magistrates who wear themselves out for the age—not something my meager virtue could conjure!"
units.literal: Mengxun said: "These all are what two-thousand-bushel magistrates and chiefs, not sparing body, aid the times and bring about—how could my slight virtue be able to move them!"

units.zh: 蒙遜率步騎三萬伐禿髮傉檀，次於西郡。
units.en: Mengxun marched on Tufa Nutan at the head of thirty thousand men and halted at Xijun.
units.literal: Mengxun led thirty thousand foot and horse to campaign against Tufa Nutan, halted at Xijun.

units.zh: 大風從西北來，氣有五色，俄而晝昏。
units.en: A gale blew from the northwest in five-colored murk until day turned twilight.
units.literal: A great wind came from the northwest; the qi had five colors; before long daylight went dark.

units.zh: 至顯美，徙數千戶而還。
units.en: He reached Xianmei, resettled several thousand households, and withdrew.
units.literal: Reaching Xianmei, he moved several thousand households and returned.

units.zh: 傉檀追及蒙遜於窮泉，蒙遜將擊之。
units.en: Nutan overtook Mengxun at Qiongquan; Mengxun prepared to give battle.
units.literal: Nutan caught up to Mengxun at Qiongquan; Mengxun was about to strike him.

units.zh: 諸將皆曰：「賊已安營，弗可犯也。」
units.en: His generals said, "The enemy is entrenched—we cannot strike."
units.literal: The generals all said: "The bandits have already settled camp—cannot be attacked.

units.zh: 蒙遜曰：「傉檀謂吾遠來疲弊，必輕而無備，及其壘壁未成，可以一鼓而滅。」
units.en: Mengxun replied, "Nutan thinks us road-weary and will be careless; before his walls are finished one charge will crush him."
units.literal: Mengxun said: "Nutan thinks I come from afar weary and worn, surely will be light and without preparation; while his ramparts are not yet finished, can be destroyed with one drum.

units.zh: 進擊，敗之，乘勝至於姑臧，夷夏降者萬數千戶。
units.en: He attacked, routed Nutan, and pressed to Guzang; ten thousand-odd households of Chinese and tribesmen surrendered.
units.literal: He advanced and struck, defeated them, riding victory to Guzang; Yi and Xia who submitted numbered ten thousand and several thousand households.

units.zh: 傉檀懼，請和，許之而歸。
units.en: Nutan sued for peace; Mengxun agreed and marched home.
units.literal: Nutan feared, requested peace; he granted it and returned.

units.zh: 及傉檀南奔樂都，魏安人焦朗據姑臧自立，蒙遜率步騎三萬攻朗，克而宥之。
units.en: After Nutan withdrew toward Ledu, Jiao Lang of Wei'an held Guzang on his own; Mengxun took thirty thousand men, took the city, and spared Jiao Lang.
units.literal: When Nutan fled south to Ledu, a man of Wei'an, Jiao Lang, seized Guzang and set himself up; Mengxun led thirty thousand foot and horse to attack Lang, overcame him and spared him.

units.zh: 饗文武將士于謙光殿，班賜金馬有差。
units.en: He feasted his officers in the Qian'guang Hall and handed out gold and horses by rank.
units.literal: He feasted civil and military officers at the Palace of Humble Light, distributing gold and horses in graded gifts.

units.zh: 以敦煌張穆博通經史，才藻清贍，擢拜中書侍郎，委以機密之任。
units.en: Zhang Mu of Dunhuang, learned and eloquent, was made gentleman of the palace secretariat and entrusted with state secrets.
units.literal: Because Dunhuang's Zhang Mu broadly penetrated the classics and histories, talent and literary polish clear and rich, he raised and appointed him palace secretary gentleman, entrusting him confidential tasks.

units.zh: 以其弟挐為護羌校尉、秦州刺史，封安平侯，鎮姑臧。
units.en: His brother Nu became colonel of the Qiang, governor of Qin, marquis of Anping, and held Guzang.
units.literal: He appointed his younger brother Nu as colonel who protects the Qiang, governor of Qin, marquis of Anping, to garrison Guzang.

units.zh: 旬餘而挐死，又以從祖益子為鎮京將軍、護羌校尉、秦州剌史，鎮姑臧。
units.en: Within a fortnight Nu died; Mengxun then named Yizi, a senior agnate of his grandfather's generation, garrison general of the capital, colonel of the Qiang, and governor of Qin to hold Guzang.
units.literal: Within a fortnight Nu died; Mengxun then named Yizi, a senior agnate of his grandfather's generation, garrison general of the capital, colonel of the Qiang, and governor of Qin to hold Guzang.

units.zh: 俄而蒙遜遷于姑臧，以義熙八年僭即河西王位，大赦境內，改元玄始。
units.en: Soon Mengxun moved his seat to Guzang; in the eighth year of Yixi he took the title of king of Hexi, proclaimed a general amnesty, and adopted the era name Xuanshi.
units.literal: Before long Mengxun moved to Guzang; in the eighth year of Yixi he usurpingly assumed the title of king of Hexi, greatly amnestied within his borders, changed era to Xuanshi.

units.zh: 置官僚，如呂光為三河王故事。
units.en: He organized a full administration on the model of Lü Guang's enthronement as king of Sanhe.
units.literal: He set up officials and clerks according to the precedent when Lü Guang became king of Sanhe.

units.zh: 繕宮殿，起城門諸觀。
units.en: He rebuilt the palaces and raised gate towers and viewing pavilions.
units.literal: He repaired palace halls and raised gate towers and belvederes.

units.zh: 立其子政德為世子，加鎮衛大將軍、錄尚書事。
units.en: He named his heir Zhengde and added the titles grand general of the guard and supervisor of the masters of writing.
units.literal: He established his son Zhengde as heir, adding grand general who guards the court and supervisor of the masters of writing.

units.zh: 傉檀來伐，蒙遜敗之於若厚塢。
units.en: When Nutan invaded, Mengxun defeated him at Ruohouwu.
units.literal: Nutan came to attack; Mengxun defeated him at Ruohouwu.

units.zh: 傉檀湟河太守文支據湟川，護軍成宜侯率眾降之。
units.en: Wen Zhi, Nutan's governor on the Huang River, held the Huangchuan, while Cheng Yi, guard commander, brought his command over to Mengxun.
units.literal: Nutan's Huanghe governor Wen Zhi held the Huangchuan; guard commander Marquis Cheng Yi led the host to submit.

units.zh: 署文支鎮東大將軍、廣武太守、振武侯，成宜侯為振威將軍、湟川太守，以殿中將軍王建為湟河太守。
units.en: He named Wen Zhi grand general of the east, governor of Guangwu, and marquis of Zhenwu; Cheng Yi general who rouses might and governor of Huangchuan; and Wang Jian of the palace guard as governor of the Huang River.
units.literal: He appointed Wen Zhi grand general who guards the east, governor of Guangwu, marquis of Zhenwu; Cheng Yi as general who rouses might, governor of Huangchuan; and palace general Wang Jian as Huanghe governor.

units.zh: 蒙遜下書曰：「古先哲王應期撥亂者，莫不經略八表，然後光闡純風。
units.en: Mengxun proclaimed, "The sage kings of old who met their hour and quelled chaos always secured the outer marches before they spread pure rule.
units.literal: Mengxun issued a writ saying: "Ancient sage kings who answered the period and set right disorder, none did not plan the eight outer regions, then afterward brightly open pure wind.

units.zh: 孤雖智非靖難，職在濟時，而狡虜傉檀鴟峙舊京，毒加夷夏。
units.en: Though I am no master of saving the age, it is my charge to aid the times, while that bandit Nutan perches like an owl on the old capital and poisons Chinese and barbarian alike.
units.literal: I, although wisdom is not that which quiets disaster, duty lies in aiding the times, yet the crafty captive Nutan owl-perches on the old capital, poison reaching Yi and Xia.

units.zh: 東苑之戮，酷甚長平，邊城之禍，害深獫狁。
units.en: The massacre in the eastern park outdid Changping; the harm to the frontier ran deeper than the Xianyun raids.
units.literal: The slaughter in the eastern park was crueler than Changping; the border cities' disaster harmed deeper than the Xianyun.

units.zh: 每念蒼生之無辜，是以不遑啟處，身疲甲胄，體倦風塵。
units.en: Whenever I think of the innocent people, I cannot rest; I wear armor until I drop and ride the dust without pause.
units.literal: Each time I think of the dark people's guiltlessness, therefore I have no leisure to rest; body weary in armor, form tired in wind and dust.

units.zh: 雖傾其巢穴，傉檀猶未授首。
units.en: Though I have torn up his lair, Nutan still lives.
units.literal: Although I have overturned his nest, Nutan still has not offered his head.

units.zh: 傉檀弟文支追項伯歸漢之義，據彼重籓，請為臣妾。
units.en: His brother Wen Zhi, like Xiang Bo who went over to Han, holds a key bastion and begs to become my subject.
units.literal: Nutan's younger brother Wen Zhi, tracing Xiang Bo's meaning in returning to Han, holds that heavy screen and requests to be minister and concubine.

units.zh: 自西平已南，連城繼順。
units.en: South of Xiping the walled towns surrender in a chain.
units.literal: From Xiping south, linked cities in succession submit.

units.zh: 惟傉檀窮獸，守死樂都。
units.en: Only Nutan, a beast at bay, clings to Ledu.
units.literal: Only Nutan, cornered beast, guards death at Ledu.

units.zh: 四支既落，命豈久全！
units.en: With his limbs cut away, how long can he last!
units.literal: The four limbs already fallen—how can life long endure!

units.zh: 五緯之會已應，清一之期無賒，方散馬金山，黎元永逸。
units.en: The conjunction of the five planets answers our rise; the day of unification is near—then we shall turn the horses loose at Jinshan and the people know lasting peace.
units.literal: The five cords' conjunction already responds; the pure-one's term not distant—then I shall loose horses at Jin Mountain and the black-haired people rest forever.

units.zh: 可露布遠近，咸使聞知。」
units.en: Let this be proclaimed far and wide so every ear may hear."
units.literal: May a bulletin be spread far and near, all causing to hear and know."

units.zh: 蒙遜西如苕藋，遣冠軍伏恩率騎一萬襲卑和、烏啼二虜，大破之，俘二千餘落而還。
units.en: Mengxun rode west to Tiaodiao and sent Fu En with ten thousand cavalry against the Boho and Wuti tribes, shattering them and bringing back over two thousand camps.
units.literal: Mengxun went west as far as Tiaodiao, sent champion Fu En leading ten thousand horse to raid the Boho and Wuti two tribes, greatly defeated them, capturing more than two thousand camps and returning.

units.zh: 蒙遜寢於新台，閹人王懷祖擊蒙遜，傷足，其妻孟氏擒斬之，夷其三族。
units.en: On the new terrace the eunuch Wang Huaizu struck at Mengxun and wounded his foot; Mengxun's wife Lady Meng seized the assassin, executed him, and wiped out three generations of his kin.
units.literal: Mengxun slept on the new terrace; eunuch Wang Huaizu struck Mengxun, wounding his foot; his wife Lady Meng seized and beheaded him, extirpated his three clans.

units.zh: 蒙遜母車氏疾篤，蒙遜升南景門，散錢以賜百姓。
units.en: When his mother Lady Che lay dying, Mengxun mounted the South View Gate and scattered coins to the people.
units.literal: Mengxun's mother Lady Che was gravely ill; Mengxun ascended the South View Gate and scattered cash to bestow the hundred surnames.

units.zh: 下書曰：「孤庶憑宗廟之靈，乾坤之祐，濟否剝之運會，拯遺黎之荼蓼，上望掃清氣穢，下冀保寧家福。
units.en: He issued an edict: "I trust in the spirits of the altars and the favor of Heaven and earth to cross this evil time and lift the people from their misery, to cleanse the foul air above and bring peace to every home below.
units.literal: He issued a writ saying: "I hope to rely on the ancestral temple's spirit, Heaven and Earth's blessing, to ford the not-yet-stripped turning, save the surviving black-haired from bitter herbs, above hope to sweep clear foul qi, below hope to protect and quiet household blessing.

units.zh: 而太后不豫，涉歲彌增，將刑獄枉濫，眾有怨乎？
units.en: Yet the queen mother's illness lingers—are judgments unjust or the people nursing grievances?
units.literal: Yet the grand empress dowager is unwell, crossing the year it grows—could it be that punishments and prisons are bent and excessive, the masses harbor resentment?

units.zh: 賦役繁重，時不堪乎？
units.en: Are taxes and labor too heavy for the times to bear?
units.literal: Are taxes and corvée heavy and pressing, the times unbearable?

units.zh: 群望不絜，神所譴乎？
units.en: Have the spirits turned away because our sacrifices are unclean?
units.literal: Are the various sacrificial cults impure, condemned by the spirits?

units.zh: 內省諸身，未知罪之攸在。
units.en: I search my heart and cannot see my fault.
units.literal: Inwardly examining all bodies, I do not know where crime lies.

units.zh: 可大赦殊死已下。」
units.en: Let there be a sweeping amnesty short of capital crimes."
units.literal: May there be a great amnesty down to those not guilty of capital crime."

units.zh: 俄而車氏死。
units.en: Soon Lady Che died.
units.literal: Before long Lady Che died.

units.zh: 蒙遜遣其將運糧於湟河，自率眾攻克乞伏熾磐廣武郡。
units.en: He sent troops to convoy grain to the Huang River while he himself stormed Qifu Chipan's Guangwu commandery.
units.literal: Mengxun sent his generals to transport grain to the Huang River; he personally led the host to overcome Qifu Chipan's Guangwu commandery.

units.zh: 以運糧不繼，自廣武如湟河，度浩亹。
units.en: When supplies failed he moved from Guangwu toward the Huang River and crossed Haoqian.
units.literal: Because transport grain did not continue, from Guangwu went to the Huang River, crossing Haoqian.

units.zh: 熾磐遣將乞伏魋尼寅距蒙遜，蒙遜擊斬之。
units.en: Chipan sent Qifu Tuiniiyin to block him; Mengxun attacked and killed him.
units.literal: Chipan sent general Qifu Kuini Yin to oppose Mengxun; Mengxun struck and beheaded him.

units.zh: 熾磐又遣將王衡、折斐、麹景等率騎一萬據勒姐嶺，蒙遜且戰且前，大破之，擒折斐等七百餘人，麹景奔還。
units.en: Chipan sent Wang Heng, Zhe Fei, and Qu Jing with ten thousand horse to hold Lejieling; Mengxun fought his way forward, routed them, took Zhe Fei and seven hundred others, while Qu Jing fled.
units.literal: Chipan again sent generals Wang Heng, Zhe Fei, Qu Jing and others leading ten thousand horse to hold Lejieling; Mengxun fought while advancing, greatly defeated them, capturing Zhe Fei and more than seven hundred; Qu Jing fled back.

units.zh: 蒙遜以弟漢平為折沖將軍、湟河太守，乃引還。
units.en: He named his brother Hanping general who breaks the charge and governor of the Huang River, then withdrew.
units.literal: Mengxun appointed his younger brother Hanping as general who breaks the charge, Huang River governor, then led back.

units.zh: 晉益州刺史硃齡石遣使來聘。
units.en: Zhu Lingshi, governor of Yi for the Eastern Jin, sent envoys on a courtesy mission.
units.literal: Jin's governor of Yi, Zhu Lingshi, dispatched envoys to visit.

units.zh: 蒙遜遣舍人黃迅報聘益州，因表曰：「上天降禍，四海分崩，靈耀擁于南裔，蒼生沒於醜虜。
units.en: Mengxun sent the houseman Huang Xun to return the courtesy visit to Yi and submitted a memorial: "Heaven has scourged the realm; the empire is broken; the royal sun hangs over the south while the people lie under barbarian hooves.
units.literal: Mengxun sent houseman Huang Xun to return the visit to Yi and submitted a memorial saying: "Heaven above sent disaster; the four seas split apart; the numinous radiance is stalled in the southern marches while the black-haired sink among ugly captives.

units.zh: 陛下累聖重光，道邁周、漢，純風所被，八表宅心。
units.en: Your Majesty, sage upon sage, surpasses Zhou and Han; wherever your virtue reaches, the eight quarters turn their hearts to you.
units.literal: Your Majesty, piled sage and repeated light, the Way surpasses Zhou and Han; the pure wind's covering—within the eight extremities all dwell in heart.

units.zh: 臣雖被髮邊徼，才非時雋，謬為河右遺黎推為盟主。
units.en: I, though a tribesman on the frontier and no genius of the age, have been chosen leader by the people west of the River.
units.literal: Your subject, although hair unbound on the border, talent not the age's outstanding, wrongly am by Hexi's surviving people pushed as covenant lord.

units.zh: 臣之先人，世荷恩寵，雖曆夷險，執義不回，傾首陽，乃心王室。
units.en: My forebears received your grace generation after generation; through every trial they kept faith and never turned their faces from the Jin sun.
units.literal: Your subject's ancestors, generation receiving grace and favor, although passing through barbarian peril, held righteousness and did not turn; bowing to the sun, then heart in the royal house.

units.zh: 去冬益州刺史硃齡石遣使詣臣，始具朝廷休問。
units.en: Last winter Zhu Lingshi's envoy brought me word of the court's health and favor.
units.literal: Last winter Governor of Yi Zhu Lingshi sent an envoy to your subject, beginning fully to convey the court's good rest and inquiry.

units.zh: 承車騎將軍劉裕秣馬揮戈，以中原為事，可謂天贊大晉，篤生英輔。
units.en: I hear Liu Yu, general of chariots and cavalry, is shoeing horses and raising spears for the Central Plain—surely Heaven aids great Jin and has sent a true champion.
units.literal: I hear the chariot-and-cavalry general Liu Yu is rubbing horses and wielding spears, taking the central plains as his affair—this can be called Heaven aiding great Jin, richly producing heroic assistant.

units.zh: 臣聞少康之興大夏，光武之復漢業，皆奮劍而起，眾無一旅，猶能成配天之功，著《車攻》之詠。
units.en: I recall how Shaokang restored Xia and Guangwu rebuilt Han with a sword in hand and barely a regiment, yet their deeds matched Heaven and were sung in the ode Chegong.
units.literal: Your subject has heard that Shaokang's raising Great Xia, Guangwu's restoring Han enterprise, both grasped sword and rose, the host not one brigade, still were able to complete merit matching Heaven, manifest the ode Chegong's chant.

units.zh: 陛下據全楚之地，擁荊、揚之銳，而可垂拱晏然，棄二京以資戎虜！
units.en: You hold all of Chu and the spear-points of Jing and Yang—can you sit idle and yield the two capitals to the nomads!
units.literal: Your Majesty occupies all Chu land, holds Jing and Yang's keen edge—yet can hang sleeves in ease, abandon the two capitals to supply barbarian captives!

units.zh: 若六軍北軫，克復有期，臣請率河西戎為晉右翼前驅。」
units.en: When the six hosts wheel north and a day of reconquest is set, I beg to lead the Rong of the west river as the vanguard on your right wing."
units.literal: If the six armies turn north and recovery has a date, your subject begs to lead the Hexi Rong as Jin's right wing and vanguard."

units.zh: 熾磐率眾三萬襲湟河，漢平力戰固守，遣司馬隗仁夜出擊熾磐，斬級數百。
units.en: Chipan struck the Huang River with thirty thousand men; Hanping held fast and sent Wei Ren by night against Chipan, who lost several hundred heads.
units.literal: Chipan led a host of thirty thousand to raid the Huang River; Hanping fought hard to hold firm, sent major Wei Ren to strike by night against Chipan, beheading several hundred ranks.

units.zh: 熾磐將引退，先遣老弱。
units.en: Chipan prepared to withdraw, sending out the old and weak first.
units.literal: Chipan was about to lead away, first sending old and weak.

units.zh: 漢平長史焦昶、將軍段景密信招熾磐，熾磐復進攻漢平。
units.en: Jiao Chang and Duan Jing secretly invited Chipan in; Chipan advanced again against Hanping.
units.literal: Hanping's senior clerk Jiao Chang and general Duan Jing secretly by letter summoned Chipan; Chipan again advanced to attack Hanping.

units.zh: 漢平納昶、景之說，而縛出降。
units.en: Hanping listened to Jiao Chang and Duan Jing, bound himself, and came out to surrender.
units.literal: Hanping accepted Chang and Jing's persuasion and bound himself to come out and surrender.

units.zh: 仁勒壯士百餘據南門樓上，三日不下，眾寡不敵，為熾磐所擒。
units.en: Wei Ren held the south gate tower for three days with a hundred men until, overwhelmed, Chipan took him.
units.literal: Ren urged a hundred stalwarts to hold the south gate tower three days without coming down; few could not match many, was seized by Chipan.

units.zh: 熾磐怒，命斬之。
units.en: Chipan in his rage ordered his execution.
units.literal: Chipan was angry, ordered him beheaded.

units.zh: 段暉諫曰：「仁臨難履危，奮不顧命，忠也。
units.en: Duan Hui urged him, "Wei Ren faced death fearlessly—that is loyalty.
units.literal: Duan Hui remonstrated saying: "Ren faced peril and trod danger, roused without sparing life—loyal.

units.zh: 宜宥之，以厲事君。」
units.en: Spare him to teach others how to serve a lord."
units.literal: Ought to pardon him, thereby to encourage serving the lord."

units.zh: 熾磐乃執之而歸。
units.en: Chipan seized Wei Ren and carried him off.
units.literal: Chipan thereupon seized him and took him back.

units.zh: 在熾磐所五年，暉又為之固請，乃得還姑臧。
units.en: Wei Ren spent five years in Chipan's hands until Duan Hui again pleaded for him and he was allowed to return to Guzang.
units.literal: At Chipan's place five years; Hui again for him firmly requested; then was able to return to Guzang.

units.zh: 及至，蒙遜執其手曰：「卿孤之蘇武也！」
units.en: When he came home, Mengxun took his hand and said, "You are my Su Wu!"
units.literal: When he arrived, Mengxun grasped his hand saying: "You are my Su Wu!"

units.zh: 以為高昌太守。
units.en: Mengxun named him governor of Gaochang.
units.literal: He was appointed Gaochang governor.

units.zh: 為政有威惠之稱，然頗以愛財為失。
units.en: As an administrator he combined firmness with kindness, though he was faulted for greed.
units.literal: In governing he had a reputation for awe and grace, yet rather by loving wealth was at fault.

units.zh: 蒙遜西祀金山，遣沮渠廣宗率騎一萬襲烏啼虜，大捷而還。
units.en: Mengxun offered sacrifice west of Jin Mountain and sent Juqu Guangzong with ten thousand cavalry against the Wuti tribes, winning a great victory.
units.literal: Mengxun sacrificed west at Jin Mountain, sent Juqu Guangzong leading ten thousand horse to raid the Wuti tribe, great victory and returned.

units.zh: 蒙遜西至苕藋，遣前將軍沮渠成都將騎五千襲卑和虜，蒙遜率中軍三萬繼之，卑和虜率眾迎降。
units.en: He rode to Tiaodiao and sent Juqu Chengdu with five thousand horse against the Bohe while he followed with thirty thousand from the center; the Bohe came out to surrender.
units.literal: Mengxun went west to Tiaodiao, sent vanguard general Juqu Chengdu leading five thousand horse to raid the Bohe tribe; Mengxun led the central army thirty thousand following; the Bohe tribe led the host to meet and submit.

units.zh: 遂循海而西，至鹽池，祀西王母寺。
units.en: He then followed the shore west to the salt lakes and sacrificed at the temple of the Queen Mother of the West.
units.literal: Thereupon followed the sea westward, reaching Salt Pool, sacrificing at the Queen Mother of the West temple.

units.zh: 寺中有《玄石神圖》，命其中書侍郎張穆賦焉，銘之於寺前，遂如金山而歸。
units.en: The temple held the sacred chart on the black stone; he had Zhang Mu compose a fu on it, carved the text before the gate, and returned by way of Jin Mountain.
units.literal: In the temple was the "Mysterious Stone Spirit Chart"; he ordered palace secretary Zhang Mu to rhapsodize it, inscribed it before the temple, then went as far as Jin Mountain and returned.

units.zh: 蒙遜下書曰：「頃自春炎旱，害及時苗，碧原青野，倏為枯壤。
units.en: He proclaimed, "Since spring a killing drought has blasted the young crops and turned green fields to dust.
units.literal: Mengxun issued a writ saying: "Recently from spring scorching drought has harmed the season's seedlings; jade plain green wilds suddenly became withered soil.

units.zh: 將刑政失中，下有冤獄乎？
units.en: Are judgments unjust and innocent men in chains?
units.literal: Could it be that punishments and government miss the mean, below there are unjust prisons?

units.zh: 役繁賦重，上天所譴乎？
units.en: Are taxes and labor so heavy that Heaven punishes us?
units.literal: Are corvée heavy and taxes weighty, what Heaven condemns?

units.zh: 內省多缺，孤之罪也。
units.en: The fault is mine alone.
units.literal: Inward examination finds many lacks—it is I alone who am guilty.

units.zh: 《書》不雲乎：'百姓有過，罪予一人。
units.en: The Book of Documents says, 'If the people err, the blame is mine.'
units.literal: Does not the Document say: 'When the hundred surnames have fault, the crime is on me alone.'

units.zh: '可大赦殊死已下。」
units.en: Grant a broad amnesty short of capital crimes."
units.literal: May there be a great amnesty down to those not guilty of capital crime.

units.zh: 翌日而澍雨大降。
units.en: The next day a soaking rain fell.
units.literal: The next day soaking rain fell greatly.

units.zh: 蒙遜聞劉裕滅姚泓，怒甚。
units.en: When word came that Liu Yu had destroyed Yao Hong, Mengxun flew into a rage.
units.literal: Mengxun heard Liu Yu had extinguished Yao Hong, was very angry.

units.zh: 門下校郎劉祥言事于蒙遜，蒙遜曰：「汝聞劉裕入關，敢研研然也！」
units.en: Liu Xiang offered advice; Mengxun snarled, "You heard that Liu Yu had entered the passes and grew insolent!"
units.literal: Gatehouse collating officer Liu Xiang spoke on affairs to Mengxun; Mengxun said: "You heard Liu Yu enter the passes, dare to be so pleased with yourself!"

units.zh: 遂殺之。
units.en: He had Liu Xiang killed.
units.literal: Thereupon killed him.

units.zh: 其峻暴如是。
units.en: Such was his harsh and violent temper.
units.literal: His severity and violence were like this.

units.zh: 顧謂左右曰：「古之行師，不犯歲鎮所在。
units.en: He told his attendants, "The ancients never campaigned against the station of the year star and the garrison planet.
units.literal: He turned and said to left and right: "Of old when marching armies, one did not offend against the year star and the garrison star's seat.

units.zh: 姚氏舜後，軒轅之苗裔也。
units.en: The Yao clan are Shun's line and the blood of the Yellow Thearch.
units.literal: The Yao house is Shun's posterity, Xuanyuan's descendants.

units.zh: 今鎮星在軒轅，而裕滅之，亦不能久守關中。」
units.en: The garrison star now stands in Xuanyuan, yet Liu Yu has destroyed Qin—he too will not long hold Guanzhong."
units.literal: Now the garrison star is in Xuanyuan, yet Yu destroyed them—also cannot long hold Guanzhong."

units.zh: 蒙遜為李士業敗于解支澗，復收散卒欲戰。
units.en: Mengxun was routed by Li Shiye at Jiezhi Creek and tried to rally his broken troops for another round.
units.literal: Mengxun was by Li Shiye defeated at Jiezhi Stream, again gathered scattered soldiers desiring to fight.

units.zh: 前將軍成都諫曰：「臣聞高祖有彭城之敗，終成大漢，宜旋師以為後圖。」
units.en: Juqu Chengdu urged him, "Even the Han founder lost at Pengcheng yet built the dynasty—you should withdraw and plan again."
units.literal: Vanguard general Chengdu remonstrated saying: "Your subject has heard the High Ancestor had Pengcheng's defeat, yet in the end completed great Han—fit to turn the army for later planning.

units.zh: 蒙遜從之，城建康而歸。
units.en: Mengxun agreed, walled Jiankang, and marched home.
units.literal: Mengxun followed it, encamped at Jiankang commandery and returned.

units.zh: 其群下上書曰：「設官分職，所以經國濟時；
units.en: His officers wrote, "Offices exist to govern the state and meet the hour;
units.literal: Their host of subordinates submitted memorial saying: "Setting offices and dividing duties is the means to order the state and aid the times;

units.zh: 恪動官次，所以緝熙庶政。
units.en: orderly ranks keep every task in hand;
units.literal: respectfully moving official order is the means to brighten the myriad tasks.

units.zh: 當官者以匪躬為務，受任者以忘身為效。
units.en: ministers should give their bodies to duty and forget themselves in service.
units.literal: Those who hold office take not sparing body as task; those who receive charge take forgetting self as effect.

units.zh: 自皇綱初震，戎馬生郊，公私草創，未遑舊式。
units.en: Since the dynasty shook, armies have tramped the borders, government was thrown together, and old regulations were neglected.
units.literal: Since the royal net first quaked, war horses were born in the suburbs, public and private in rough founding, not yet leisure for old pattern.

units.zh: 而朝士多違憲制，不遵典章；
units.en: Many officials flout the code;
units.literal: Yet court gentlemen mostly violate the statutes and do not follow canons and rules;

units.zh: 或公文御案，在家臥署；
units.en: some sign papers from their beds at home;
units.literal: some with official documents on the imperial desk, sign from home lying down;

units.zh: 或事無可否，望空而過。
units.en: some let business pass unanswered.
units.literal: some affairs neither yea nor nay, pass empty and gone.

units.zh: 至今黜陟絕於皇朝，駁議寢於聖世，清濁共流，能否相雜，人無勸競之心，苟為度日之事。
units.en: Promotions and reviews no longer reach the throne; the worthy and the base are jumbled together and no one strives—only marking time.
units.literal: Down to now demotion and promotion are cut off from the imperial court, refutation and deliberation sleep in this sage age—clear and muddy flow together, able and unable mix; men lack mind to strive and compete, merely pass the days.

units.zh: 豈憂公忘私，奉上之道也！
units.en: That is no way to serve the state or the throne!
units.literal: How is this the way of worrying for the state, forgetting self, serving what is above!

units.zh: 今皇化曰隆，遐邇寧泰，宜肅振綱維，申修舊則。」
units.en: Now your virtue grows daily and the realm is calmer—it is time to tighten discipline and restore the old rules."
units.literal: Now royal transformation daily rises, far and near quiet and peaceful—fit to sternly shake the net's cords, declare and repair old rules.

units.zh: 蒙遜納之，命征南姚艾、尚書左丞房晷撰朝堂制。
units.en: Mengxun agreed and told Yao Ai and Fang Gui to draft regulations for the court hall.
units.literal: Mengxun accepted it, ordered south-conquest Yao Ai and masters of writing left aide Fang Gui to compose court-hall regulations.

units.zh: 行之旬日，百僚振肅。
units.en: Within ten days every office stood in awe.
units.literal: Put in practice ten days; the hundred officials shook and were solemn.

units.zh: 太史令張衍言于蒙遜曰：「今歲臨澤城西當有破兵。」
units.en: Zhang Yan, director of astrology, said, "This year an army will be broken west of Linze."
units.literal: Astrologer-in-chief Zhang Yan spoke to Mengxun saying: "This year west of Linze city ought to have defeated troops.

units.zh: 蒙遜乃遣其世子政德屯兵若厚塢。
units.en: Mengxun therefore stationed his heir Zhengde at Ruohouwu.
units.literal: Mengxun thereupon sent his heir Zhengde to encamp troops at Ruohouwu.

units.zh: 蒙遜西至白岸，謂張衍曰：「吾今年當有所定，但太歲在申，月又建申，未可西行。
units.en: At Bai'an he told Zhang Yan, "I should win a field this year, yet the Grand Year and the month both stand in shen—I must not march west.
units.literal: Mengxun went west to Bai'an, said to Zhang Yan: "This year I ought to settle something, but Grand Year is in shen and the month is also founded shen—not yet able to go west.

units.zh: 且當南巡，要其歸會，主而勿客，以順天心。
units.en: I shall tour south instead, wait for the enemy to gather, keep the initiative, and follow Heaven's intent.
units.literal: For the nonce ought to tour south, await their returning conjunction, be host and not guest, thereby to follow Heaven's heart.

units.zh: 計在臨機，慎勿露也。」
units.en: Tell no one; we shall decide as events unfold."
units.literal: The plan lies in adapting to the moment—careful not to reveal it.

units.zh: 遂攻浩亹，而蛇盤於帳前。
units.en: He struck at Haoqian, and a serpent coiled before his tent.
units.literal: Thereupon attacked Haoqian, while a snake coiled before the tent.

units.zh: 蒙遜笑曰：「前一為騰蛇，今盤在吾帳，天意欲吾回師先定酒泉。」
units.en: He laughed and said, "First came the omen of the soaring serpent; now it coils in my tent—Heaven orders me to wheel about and take Jiuquan first."
units.literal: Mengxun laughed saying: "The former one was soaring snake; now it coils in my tent—Heaven's intent wishes me to turn the army and first settle Jiuquan.

units.zh: 燒攻具而還，次於川岩。
units.en: He burned his siege train, fell back, and camped at Chuanyan.
units.literal: He burned siege engines and returned, halted at Chuanyan.

units.zh: 聞李士業徵兵欲攻張掖，蒙遜曰：「入吾計矣。
units.en: When he learned that Li Shiye was raising an army for Zhangye, he said, "He has walked into my trap.
units.literal: He heard Li Shiye was levying troops intending to attack Zhangye; Mengxun said: "He has entered my plan.

units.zh: 但恐聞吾回軍，不敢前也。
units.en: I only fear he will hang back if he hears I have turned back.
units.literal: Only I fear hearing my returning army, he will not dare advance.

units.zh: 兵事尚權。」
units.en: War turns on deception."
units.literal: Military affairs esteem shifting advantage.

units.zh: 乃露布西境，稱得浩亹，將進軍黃穀。
units.en: He published word along the frontier that he had seized Haoqian and would push on to Huanggu.
units.literal: Thereupon spread bulletin on the western marches, claiming to have taken Haoqian and intending to advance to Huanggu.

units.zh: 士業聞而大悅，進入都瀆澗。
units.en: Shiye rejoiced, marched into Dudujian,
units.literal: Shiye heard and was greatly pleased, advanced and entered Dudujian.

units.zh: 蒙遜潛軍逆之，敗士業於壞城，遂進克酒泉。
units.en: while Mengxun stole up, broke him at Huai city, and stormed Jiuquan.
units.literal: Mengxun secretly moved troops to intercept him, defeated Shiye at Huai city, thereupon advanced and took Jiuquan.

units.zh: 百姓安堵如故，軍無私焉。
units.en: The people were left undisturbed and the troops took no private plunder.
units.literal: The hundred surnames were settled and blocked as before; the army took nothing private.

units.zh: 以子茂虔為酒泉太守，士業舊臣皆隨才擢敘。
units.en: He named his son Maoqian governor of Jiuquan and employed Shiye's former officers by their abilities.
units.literal: He appointed his son Maoqian as Jiuquan governor; Shiye's old ministers each were raised according to talent.

units.zh: 蒙遜以安帝隆安五年自稱州牧，義熙八年僭立，後八年而宋氏受禪，以元嘉十年死，時年六十六，在偽位三十三年。
units.en: He first called himself governor of the province in the fifth year of Long'an under Emperor An, seized the royal title in the eighth year of Yixi, saw the Song accept the abdication eight years later, and died in the tenth year of Yuanjia at sixty-six, having reigned thirty-three years in all.
units.literal: Mengxun in Emperor An's fifth year of Long'an styled himself shepherd of the province; in the eighth year of Yixi he usurped the throne; after eight years the Song house received the abdication; in the tenth year of Yuanjia he died, at the time age sixty-six, on the false throne thirty-three years.

units.zh: 子茂虔立，六年，為魏所擒，合三十九載而滅。
units.en: His son Maoqian ruled six years before Wei captured him; thirty-nine years in all from rise to fall.
units.literal: Son Maoqian succeeded; in the sixth year was seized by Wei—together thirty-nine years then extinguished.

units.zh: 史臣曰：蒙遜出自夷陬，擅雄邊塞。
units.en: The historians write: Mengxun rose from the tribal marches and seized power beyond the passes.
units.literal: The historian says: Mengxun came from barbarian borderlands, monopolized might on the frontier.

units.zh: 屬呂光之悖德，深懷仇粥之冤；
units.en: When Lü Guang turned cruel, he deeply harbored the grievance of Quzhou;
units.literal: Meeting Lü Guang's contrary virtue, he deeply cherished the wrong done Quzhou;

units.zh: 推段業以濟時，假以陳、吳之事。
units.en: he raised Duan Ye as a banner for the hour, as Chen Sheng and Wu Guang once did;
units.literal: He raised Duan Ye to aid the times, borrowing the deeds of Chen Sheng and Wu Guang.

units.zh: 稱兵白澗，南涼請和；
units.en: he mustered troops at Baijian and forced Southern Liang to sue for peace;
units.literal: He called arms at Baijian; Southern Liang requested peace;

units.zh: 出師丹嶺，北寇賓服。
units.en: he marched from Danling and brought the northern tribes to heel.
units.literal: He sent out the army at Danling; northern raiders submitted as guests.

units.zh: 然而見利忘義，苞禍滅親，雖能制命一隅，抑亦備諸凶德者矣。
units.en: He forgot duty for gain, harbored treachery, and slew his own kin; master of a corner though he was, he ranks among the vicious.
units.literal: Yet seeing profit he forgot righteousness, harbored disaster and destroyed kin—although able to command fate in one corner, still he may be counted among those stocked with every vicious trait.

units.zh: 贊曰：光猜人傑，業忌時賢。
units.en: The encomium runs: Lü Guang feared great men; Duan Ye resented talent;
units.literal: The encomium says: Guang suspected the heroic; Ye envied the worthy of the hour.

units.zh: 游飲自晦，匿智圖全。
units.en: Mengxun feasted and played the fool while plotting his survival;
units.literal: Roaming and drinking to dim himself, he hid wisdom to seek survival.

units.zh: 凶心既逞，偽績攸宣。
units.en: when his cruel heart had its way, his usurpation showed plain;
units.literal: Once his cruel heart had its way, his usurped deeds were proclaimed.

units.zh: 挺茲奸數，馳競當年。
units.en: such cunning drove him to scramble for power in his time.
units.literal: He bore such craft and cunning, racing for power in his day.
